2780: Yang Wenli is a commodore, currently serving in the 2nd fleet of the Free Planets Alliance.
3066: Count Reinhard von Lohengramm is a young admiral in the Galactic Empire. He was born Reinhard von Müsel to an impoverished aristocratic family. His mother died when he was very young and he only has faint memories of her.
3869: Dusty first met Yang Wen-Li at the military academy in 785UC, and they have been friends ever since. First Lieutenant Dusty Attenborough began a distinguished military career during the 5th Iserlohn Assault in 792UC.
5897: Commander of the Rosenritters, a brigade composed of former Imperial citizens who have defected or escaped to the Alliance. They are known for their skill and brutality in battle, but are mistrusted for their Imperial ties.
6026: Oskar von Reuenthal is a rear admiral serving in Reinhard’s fleet and, along with Wolfgang Mittermeyer, Reinhard’s ablest field commander.
6717: Initially one of the five Admirals serving under Reinhard von Lohengramm at the beginning of the series.
10773: A young doctor in training who serves as Reinhard's personal servant.
12550: Siegfried Kircheis was an Imperial high admiral who was most notable for his role as the best friend and personal confidant of Reinhard von Lohengramm since childhood, who later became his top admiral.
12778: Wolfgang Mittermeyer is a rear admiral serving in Reinhard’s fleet and, along with Oskar von Reuenthal, Reinhard’s ablest field commander. Mittermeyer is a commoner, born to a middle-class family.
12779: Julian Mintz is the son of a soldier who served in the Alliance’s army, he lost his mother at a very young age and, some years later, his father was killed in battle leaving him a war-orphan.
12895: Vice Admiral in the Galactic Empire, leader of the Schwarz lanzenreiters (Black Lancers), a fleet renowned for their shock assault tactics and fondness of high speed battleships. His flagship is the Köenigs Tiger.
12896: Vice Admiral in the Galactic Empire.
12897: Starts as a Commodore the Galactic Empire, under Reinhard rule he's one of the High Admirals and chief of the military police.
12898: Paul von Oberstein is a captain serving as chief of staff in fortress Iserlohn of the Galactic Empire. He was born blind and has to wear artificial eyes to see.
12899: Leader of the autonomous planet Phezzan. He's always plotting and scheming to keep the war between Free Planets Alliance and the Galactic Empire in the status quo.
13100: Reinhard's older sister, sold at young age to the Imperial palace.
13101: One of the best pilots of a spartanian in the Free Planet Alliance, he is well known for being a womanizer.
13857: Illegitimate daughter of Walter von Schenkopp and a fighter pilot in the FPA.
14506: High Admiral in the Galactic Empire
17789: Frederica Greenhill first met Yang during the evacuation of El Facil. She joined the military to find him again and was assigned as his adjutant.
19468: Jessica became involved in anti-war politics after her fiance died at the Battle of Astate. The Patriotic Knights Corp harassed her until intervention by Yang Wenli, a longtime friend of both Jessica and Jean Lappe.
19474: Job is a politician all the way. Like most of his kind, he acts more out of his own interest and gain than the interest of people. Job projects that the war being fought is a holy one, against the evil of the Galactic Empire.
19475: Alexander ("Old Man") Bucock has led a distinguished military career. In 745UC he fought in the Second Tiamat Battle. More recently, Vice Admiral Bucock fought in the Van Fleet Starzone Battle. and the Third Tiamat Battle.
21615: Heinrich von Kümmel was a cousin to Hildegard von Lohengramm. Due to his chronically (indeed, terminally) poor health, he seemed to have been bed-ridden for most or all of his life, thus giving him the appearance of a man well older than he actually was.
21713: One of the High Admirals in the Empire.
22635: Alex Caselnes is a vice admiral serving in the Free Planets Alliance. A genius at logistics, he is a military bureaucrat expertising in supply and rear-line support.
23849: High Admiral in the empire, Nicknamed the "Silent Admiral" by his Peers due to the fact that he rarely seems to speak. He communicates through gestures and hand signals.
23995: Archbishop of the Terraist Cult and a prodigious schemer. Has a great fondness for wine, and secretly mocks the whole organization.
23997: Friend of Poplan and Spartanian pilot. Unlike his energetic friend who "doesn't miss any skirt", Ivan is more calm and likes to solve crosswords. However he always compete with Poplan on the ammount of enemy ships destroyed.
24153: Tonio is a gunner for the empire. He is originally seen aboard Reinhard's flagship, the "Brünhild", and soon after on Kircheis' flagship, the "Barbarossa".
24154: Kurt is an empire gunner, who serves on Reinhard's Flagship, the "Brünhild", and Kircheis' flagship, the "Barbarossa". More accustomed to battle than his younger counterpart Tonio, Kurt is very laid-back, and prefers not to worry about the possibility of dying in war.
24155: Jean Robert Lap is a talented lieutenant commander for the Free Planets Alliance. He is both a former schoolmate and old friend of Yang Wen-Li, and the fiancée of Jessica Edwards. He served as an operations staff officer in the 6th fleet of the Battle of Astate.
24172: Bagdash is a commander in the Alliance forces. During the battle at the Doria starzone, he "deserted" the National Salvation Military Council (which had staged a coup d'état on the planet Heinessen).
24315: An Admiral in the empire, served under Admiral Lennenkanpt, and was later assigned a fleet and flagship, garnered the nickname "Explorer Admiral" for his superior geographical skills.
24317: An admiral in the Empire, served under admiral Lennenkanpt, was later assigned a fleet and flagship.
24407: One of the High Admirals in the Empire, best known for his incredible marksmanship.
25672: A petty officer who was Julian's bodyguard.
27952: A member of the Yang Fleet.
27953: A member of the Yang fleet who specializes in fleet maneuvers.
27956: The leader of the aristocrats, and a true schemer. A prince by marriage to the Goldenbaum family, and distantly the Littenheim family.
27977: A young admiral in the empire serving under Wolfgang Mittermeyer, later assigned a fleet and flagship.
27978: An Admiral in the Alliance and leader of the first fleet.
27981: A member of the Rozen Ritters. Like Schenkopp, he too is an Imperial Ex-patriot. In 795UC (March), First Lieutenant Kasper Linz participated in the battle at Van Fleet Starzone. Due to his performance in battle, he was promoted to Major.
27983: A Member of the Rozen Ritters.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
40294: Dominique Saint-Pierré was a Phezzani who was associated with Adrian Rubinsky and Rupert Kesselring. A famous pop star, she owned several lavish homes which were suitable to hide Rubinsky when Phezzan fell to occupation.
69917: Alexander Barthauser was an admiral of the Reuenthal Fleet. Commanding a small fleet of 2,400 ships, Fleet Admiral Oskar von Reuenthal would put Barthauser's unit into action when a small force could potentially change the course of the battle.
69919: Sussana von Beenemünde was Imperial Consort to Kaiser Friedrich IV for several years, before he dismissed her in favour of Annerose von Grünewald. Unable to accept losing the Emperor's favour, Beenemünde hatched several plots to win back Friedrich's favor.
69921: Hans Eduard Bergengrün was an Imperial Captain who served under Rear Admiral Siegfried Kircheis.
69971: Rudolf von Goldenbaum was the founder and first emperor of the Galactic Empire. He was born in 268 UC and died in 42 IC at the age of 83.
69999: Franz von Mariendorf was a member of the nobility, he is best known for helping to implement major reforms and holding the position of Secretary of State, as well as being the father of the empress and regent of the Goldenlöwe Dynasty, Hildegard von Lohengramm.
70001: Evangelin Mittermeyer was the childhood friend, and later wife of Imperial Fleet admiral Wolfgang Mittermeyer.
70009: Nguyen Kim Hua was the best friend and successor of Arle Heinessen, and the founder of the Free Planets Alliance.
70025: Emil von Reckendorf was an Imperial lieutenant commander who served under Oskar von Reuenthal.
70045: Bruno von Silberberch was an Imperial minister of industry who served under Kaiser Reinhard von Lohengramm beginning in 799 UC.
70141: Charlotte Phyllis Cazellnu was the oldest daughter of Alex and Hortense Cazellnu.
70149: Hortense Cazellnu was the wife of Alex Cazellnu.
74171: A Lieutenant in the Free Planets Alliance. Respects Admiral Bucock a lot.
251556: A cat that belonged to Julian Mintz. When Julian was away or tending to military duties, he was often cared for by Yang Wen-li, and later by Alex Cazerne's family.
